newsitem.title: UK: George says UK budget move in right direction.
newsitem.headline: George says UK budget move in right direction.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said on Wednesday that the fiscal tightening in Chancellor Gordon Brown's July 2 budget had gone a long way in the right direction.

Asked by the House of Commons Treasury Select Committee if he agreed that the budget had contained virtually no measures to restrain consumption, he said it had reinforced a fiscal tightening already put in place by the previous government.
"I think that certainly goes in the right direction -- I would say it goes quite a long way in the right direction."

George said he believed counter-cyclical demand management through fiscal policy was quite dangerous. "I think fiscal policy basically should be tailored to sustainability in the medium and longer term."

"I think it is dangerous because some of the assumptions that are made about the state of the cycle can change and it's much harder to actually then readjust fiscal policy than it is, for example, monetary policy," George added.
